ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a weighted undirected graph, with A on the left end, B on the right end, and four towns in the middle. According to left-to-right and upper-lower positions, they are labeled as: upper-left node T, lower-left node L, upper-middle node C, lower-right node R. The fares between adjacent towns in the figure are marked on the edges: A-T is 20, A-L is 90, T-L is 60, T-C is 10, L-C is 30, L-R is 20, C-R is 60, C-B is 70, R-B is 10. Reasoning: To spend the least from A to B, these fares can be regarded as edge weights and the shortest path can be found. Starting from A: the cost to T is 20, and the cost to L is 90. First take the smallest-cost T=20; via T one can reach C, with cost 20+10=30; one can also reach L, with cost 20+60=80, lower than the original 90. Next take C=30; via C to L the cost is 30+30=60, update L; via C to R is 30+60=90; via C to B is 30+70=100. Next take L=60; via L to R the cost is 60+20=80, update R. Next take R=80; via R to B the cost is 80+10=90, update B. Thus the minimum cost to B is 90. The corresponding route is A-T-C-L-R-B, with cost 20+10+30+20+10=90.

raw_record.question_text: Numbers in the picture are ticket prices between neighbouring towns. Peter wants to go from A to B as cheaply as possible. What is the lowest price he has to pay?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a weighted undirected graph. Label the intermediate towns from left to right as: T = upper-left node, L = lower-left node, C = central node, R = lower-right node. From the image, record the neighbouring ticket prices: A-T 20, A-L 90, T-L 60, T-C 10, L-C 30, L-R 20, C-R 60, C-B 70, R-B 10. From the question text, interpret the task as finding the minimum total edge weight from A to B. Apply a shortest-path procedure such as Dijkstra’s algorithm: starting at A, update costs through neighbours and keep the smallest known cost to each node. This yields the cheapest route A-T-C-L-R-B with cost 20+10+30+20+10 = 90, which is lower than alternatives such as A-T-C-B = 100 or A-L-R-B = 120.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个带权无向图，左端是 A，右端是 B，中间有四个城镇。按从左到右和上下位置标记为：左上节点 T、左下节点 L、中间上方节点 C、右下节点 R。图中相邻城镇之间的票价标在边上：A-T 为 20，A-L 为 90，T-L 为 60，T-C 为 10，L-C 为 30，L-R 为 20，C-R 为 60，C-B 为 70，R-B 为 10。

推理：要从 A 到 B 花费最少，可以把这些票价看作边权并求最短路。从 A 出发：到 T 的费用是 20，到 L 的费用是 90。先取费用最小的 T=20，经 T 可到 C，费用为 20+10=30；也可到 L，费用为 20+60=80，比原来的 90 低。接着取 C=30，经 C 到 L 的费用是 30+30=60，更新 L；经 C 到 R 是 30+60=90；经 C 到 B 是 30+70=100。接着取 L=60，经 L 到 R 的费用是 60+20=80，更新 R。接着取 R=80，经 R 到 B 的费用是 80+10=90，更新 B。于是到 B 的最小费用为 90。对应路线是 A-T-C-L-R-B，费用 20+10+30+20+10=90。
